title: Umuvumo w'umusaruro mwinshi
intro: Mu gihugu cya kera, hari umuntu wari mu bakire cyane mu muryango wabo. Imigisha y’isi yari imaze kubageraho kabiri mu myaka yikurikiranya, umusaruro wikubye kabiri wagombaga gutuma imitima yabo ishima. Nyamara igihe ibyago byabaga maze byose bakabitwara mu ijoro rimwe, igisubizo cyabo cyagaragaje imiterere nyakuri y’ubugingo bwabo. Ese ushobora kuvumbura uwo muntu inkuru ye imubera umuburo wo kutizera imigisha ya Allah?
clues: Nari mu bantu bafite amahirwe menshi mu gihugu cyose, mfite umugisha wo kubona ibiryo byinshi.
Imyaka ibiri ishize nayibonye kabiri, nyamara umutima wanjye wakomeje kudashima Umwami wanjye.
Nari mfite ubusitani bwiza burimo imizabibu, imyelayo n'ibiti by'imikindo—ubuhamya bw'ubuntu bwa Allah.
Ubwo ubusitani bwanjye bwasenywaga, nahagaze mu matongo yabwo nrambuye amaboko yanjye mu ijuru, mvumira ibyanbayeho.
Nahakanye ko Allah yashoboraga guteza igihombo nk'icyo, nubwo navunitse amaboko yanjye kubera kwiheba.
Igihano cyanjye ntabwo cyari ukubura ubusitani bwanjye gusa, ahubwo cyari ukubura imbaraga mu matongo yabwo, ntashobora kwitabaza umufasha uwo ari we wese.
